newsitem.title: UK: Transport committee cancels SWT hearing.
newsitem.headline: Transport committee cancels SWT hearing.

text.p: Britain's Transport Select Committee said on Tuesday that it has cancelled a hearing into recent problems with railway franchise South West Trains (SWT).
The hearing was due to take place on Wednesday, with members of parliament set to question Stagecoach Holdings Plc, the owner of SWT, and Opraf franchise director John O'Brien.
A spokeswoman for the transport select committee was unable to provide any reasons for the cancellation of the hearing.

South West Trains has come heavy criticism recently from passenger groups and politicians following the cancellation of numerous services after job reductions left it with too few drivers to operate new shift patterns.

The passenger group Save our Railways responded to the hearing's cancellation by saying that "Conservative MPs have let South West Trains and the franchise director off the hook. This is a slap in the face for commuters who will be furious that the South West Trains fiasco will not be investigated by MPs."
